name: sourcemind
description: SourceMind AI — enterprise RAG knowledge workspace with cited, permission-aware answers.

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run typecheck --prefix client
